settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text: Find answers to the most commonly asked questions about Leafanoo. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team and we'll be happy to help.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping takes 3–7 business days within the US. Express shipping (2 business days) is available at checkout. International orders typically take 7–14 business days.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on all US orders over $50. Orders below $50 ship for a flat rate of $5.99.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy. If you're not 100% satisfied with your purchase, simply contact us and we'll arrange a free return and full refund — no questions asked.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with your tracking number. You can track your order directly on our website or through the carrier's website.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 2 hours of placement. After that, our fulfilment team will have already begun processing your order. Please contact us immediately at support@leafanoo.com.

settings.question: Are my payment details secure?
settings.answer: Absolutely. All transactions are processed through Shopify Payments which is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant — the highest level of security for online payments. Your card details are never stored on our servers.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times are calculated at checkout based on your location and chosen shipping method.

settings.question: How do I contact customer support?
settings.answer: Our customer support team is available Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm EST. You can reach us by email at support@leafanoo.com, by phone at +1 (320) 264-4135, or via our contact form.
